new.md:
Creates a new `GtkDropTarget` object.

If the drop target should support more than 1 type, pass
%G_TYPE_INVALID for `type` and then call
[`DropTarget.set_gtypes()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropTarget#method:set_gtypes).

get_current_drop.md:

If no drop operation is going on, `NULL` is returned.

reject.md:
Rejects the ongoing drop operation.

If no drop operation is ongoing, i.e when [`DropTarget:current-drop`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropTarget#property:current-drop)
is `NULL`, this function does nothing.

This function should be used when delaying the decision
on whether to accept a drag or not until after reading
the data.

preload.brief: Whether the drop data should be preloaded when the pointer is only hovering over the widget but has not been released.
preload.md:
Whether the drop data should be preloaded when the pointer is only
hovering over the widget but has not been released.

Setting this property allows finer grained reaction to an ongoing
drop at the cost of loading more data.

The default value for this property is `FALSE` to avoid downloading
huge amounts of data by accident.

For example, if somebody drags a full document of gigabytes of text
from a text editor across a widget with a preloading drop target,
this data will be downloaded, even if the data is ultimately dropped
elsewhere.

For a lot of data formats, the amount of data is very small (like
%GDK_TYPE_RGBA), so enabling this property does not hurt at all.
And for local-only Drag-and-Drop operations, no data transfer is done,
so enabling it there is free.

value.brief: The value for this drop operation.
value.md:
The value for this drop operation.

This is `NULL` if the data has not been loaded yet or no drop
operation is going on.

Data may be available before the [`DropTarget::drop`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropTarget#event:drop)
signal gets emitted - for example when the [`DropTarget:preload`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropTarget#property:preload)
property is set. You can use the ::notify signal to be notified
of available data.

accept.brief: Emitted on the drop site when a drop operation is about to begin.
accept.md:
Emitted on the drop site when a drop operation is about to begin.

If the drop is not accepted, `FALSE` will be returned and the drop target
will ignore the drop. If `TRUE` is returned, the drop is accepted for now
but may be rejected later via a call to [`DropTarget.reject()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropTarget#method:reject)
or ultimately by returning `FALSE` from a [`DropTarget::drop`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropTarget#event:drop)
handler.

The default handler for this signal decides whether to accept the drop
based on the formats provided by the `drop`.

If the decision whether the drop will be accepted or rejected depends
on the data, this function should return `TRUE`, the
[`DropTarget:preload`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropTarget#property:preload) property should be set and the value
should be inspected via the ::notify:value signal, calling
[`DropTarget.reject()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropTarget#method:reject) if required.

drop.brief: Emitted on the drop site when the user drops the data onto the widget.
drop.md:
Emitted on the drop site when the user drops the data onto the widget.

The signal handler must determine whether the pointer position is in
a drop zone or not. If it is not in a drop zone, it returns `FALSE`
and no further processing is necessary.

Otherwise, the handler returns `TRUE`. In this case, this handler will
accept the drop. The handler is responsible for using the given `value`
and performing the drop operation.

enter.brief: Emitted on the drop site when the pointer enters the widget.
enter.md:
Emitted on the drop site when the pointer enters the widget.

It can be used to set up custom highlighting.

leave.brief: Emitted on the drop site when the pointer leaves the widget.
leave.md:
Emitted on the drop site when the pointer leaves the widget.

Its main purpose it to undo things done in
[`DropTarget::enter`](xref:gtk:Gtk.DropTarget#event:enter).

motion.brief: Emitted while the pointer is moving over the drop target.
motion.md: Emitted while the pointer is moving over the drop target.
